system.description:
Half-Elf

Half-elves are the offspring of a human and an elf, combining the versatility of their human parentage with some of the grace and longevity of their elven heritage. They stand 5 to 5½ feet tall and are often taken for elves or humans at first glance. Half-elves often feel caught between two worlds, not fully accepted by either race.

Ability Score Adjustments

None — Half-elves have no racial ability score modifiers.

Racial Traits

  • Infravision: 60 feet.
  • Resistance to Sleep and Charm: 30% immunity to sleep spells and +1 bonus on saving throws vs. charm and hold spells.
  • Detect Secret and Concealed Doors: Half-elves have a 1-in-6 chance of noticing secret or concealed doors within 10 feet passively, 2-in-6 when actively searching, 3-in-6 for merely concealed doors.
  • Woodland Affinity: Half-elves retain some of the elven affinity for natural environments.

Class Restrictions

Fighter, Magic-User, Cleric, Thief, Ranger, Druid; various multiclass combinations including Fighter/Magic-User, Fighter/Thief, Cleric/Fighter, Cleric/Ranger, Cleric/Magic-User, Thief/Magic-User, Cleric/Fighter/Magic-User, Fighter/Magic-User/Thief, and Fighter/Magic-User/Cleric.
